/.title: The SozoRock Foundation | Health Access, Workforce Capacity & Trusted AI

/platforms.title: Our Work: Health Access, Workforce Capacity, AI & Society | SozoRock
/platforms.description: Three gaps we work to close: access to care, the capacity of the people who run health systems, and public trust in AI. See the programs and who leads them.

/platforms/health.title: Health Access & Primary Care Access Program | SozoRock Foundation
/platforms/health.description: Libraries, community centers and homes as trusted access points, plus a sponsored year of primary care for up to 25 New Yorkers from January 2027.

/ai-society.title: AI & Society | Building Public Trust in AI | SozoRock Foundation
/ai-society.description: Who Decides? forums and roadshows give residents, educators, employers and policymakers a real say in how AI is used in learning, work and health.

/platforms/ai-lab.title: SozoRock AI Lab | Free Practical AI Skills in Albany, NY
/platforms/ai-lab.description: Free, hands on AI learning for any background. Tuesdays at 6:30 pm in Albany, New York State. Register on the SozoRock AI Lab site.
